History Podcast: Operation Jackpot, 1971
2021-04-06T13:16:09+06:00 | Star Live Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-live/news/history-podcast-operation-jackpot-1971-2073037

Commodore Abdul Wahed Chowdhury was one of the naval commandos who participated in the Operation Jackpot in 1971. In this podcast Abdul Wahed Chowdhury shares his experience with us and tells the glorious story of Operation Jackpot.
